items.title: Anthropic IPO Valuation Collapse
points: Investors told WSJ the $1.5 trillion target is too high; one suggested a figure closer to $1 trillion, a potential 33% cut from earlier expectations.
Democratic midterm victories spooked markets: the party plans bills on AI safety and data centers with closer scrutiny of leading AI firms like Anthropic.
S&P 500 suffered its worst day since April 2025; Anthropic's Nasdaq filing (ticker ANT) last month aimed for a pre-Thanksgiving launch but now faces December timing.
Prediction markets give Anthropic 71% odds of IPO before end of 2026, up from 64% in mid-October, though valuation remains uncertain.
OpenAI IPO odds collapsed to 2% from 8%, suggesting market confidence shifted toward Anthropic's near-term listing despite valuation pressure.

items.title: Crypto Market Contagion from AI Selloff
points: Over $1 billion in crypto derivatives liquidations (forced closing of leveraged bets after adverse price moves) occurred as Bitcoin fell toward $75,500, an 11-week low, after AI stocks plunged.
Gnosis Pay disclosed that hackers accessed customer data through its branded card system, though the scope remains unclear.
The $3.1 billion Binance hack shows attackers using over 20,000 wallets across 16 blockchains without yet moving the bulk of stolen ETH and Bitcoin.

items.title: Regulatory Headwinds Drive Broader Tech Retreat
points: Democrats' sweeping midterm wins triggered plans for bills on data centers and AI safety regulation, raising compliance costs and scrutiny for AI companies.
The market reaction reflects broader investor concerns about future government oversight and potential restrictions on AI development and deployment.

items.title: DOL Crypto 401(k) Rule Under White House Review
points: A Department of Labor regulation enabling crypto options in 401(k) menus (employer-sponsored tax-advantaged US retirement savings accounts) has reached final White House review, suggesting an imminent policy decision.
If approved, the rule would let employers offer cryptocurrency (particularly bitcoin and ethereum) as investment choices alongside traditional stocks and bonds in these retirement accounts.
The move could unlock institutional demand by giving over 150 million American 401(k) participants direct exposure to digital assets, dramatically expanding crypto's mainstream accessibility.
Approval timing remains unclear but regulatory momentum suggests crypto adoption in retirement savings is advancing toward implementation.

items.title: El Salvador Expands Bitcoin National Treasury
points: El Salvador added one more bitcoin to its official government reserves, continuing its accumulation strategy under a national bitcoin-adoption policy.
The Central American nation has positioned itself as a leading sovereign holder of bitcoin via strategic state-level purchases.
Each purchase signals both a bet on bitcoin price appreciation and institutional confidence in cryptocurrency's long-term value.
